messages:
Maya Chen: Quick help — I paid for onsite AV + room block at a vendor in Munich on my personal card. Vendor invoice is higher than my card charge; invoice lists an admin/service surcharge and different VAT breakdown. Which do we reimburse and do we pay vendor directly?
Evan (Finance): Hi Maya — can you attach the vendor invoice + your card receipt here? We need to see line items and whether the invoice is billed to Redwood. If vendor invoice is in Redwood name and includes VAT ID, we can vendor-pay; otherwise we usually reimburse the employee and ask vendor for corrected paperwork.
Maya Chen: Uploading now. Invoice PDF is addressed to "Redwood Inference GmbH" but the VAT number is missing. My statement shows 515.00 EUR (card posted). Vendor invoice total shows 585.00 EUR.
UploadBot: Files uploaded: munich_av_invoice_03-2026.pdf, maya_card_stmt_mar.pdf (https://files.redwood/munich_av_invoice_03-2026.pdf)
Maya Chen: Invoice lines copied: 
"Meeting package (AV + room) 500.00 EUR
Admin/service charge 50.00 EUR
VAT 7% 35.00 EUR
Total 585.00 EUR"
Evan (Finance): Thanks. Two quick policy notes: 1) Admin/service charges are generally reimbursable if charged by the vendor, but we need correct VAT identification for vendor payments. 2) Reimbursement to the employee will be for the exact amount on their card (515.00 EUR) unless we confirm vendor payment and adjust.
Clara (Legal): Confirming: if invoice is addressed to the company we prefer vendor payment, but absence of VAT ID means we cannot claim VAT correctly. Ask vendor for updated invoice containing their VAT ID and a breakdown showing VAT amount. If time-sensitive, reimburse employee for 515.00 and recover/adjust when vendor sends corrected invoice.
Liam (Manager): I approve reimbursing Maya for the card amount now. Finance, pursue vendor correction for the remaining delta (70 EUR).
Evan (Finance): Noted. Maya — can you confirm cost object? Also want last 4 of bank for EUR payout.
Maya Chen: Cost object: TRAVEL-ENG-WKSHPS. Bank last 4: 8877. Please reimburse in EUR.
Evan (Finance): Creating expense in our system now (EXP-2026-2891). I'll put a hold on vendor payment until vendor provides VAT ID. Action: 1) Reimburse Maya 515.00 EUR via Expensify (exp id above). 2) Finance to email vendor requesting corrected VAT invoice for 70.00 EUR balance. 3) Legal to review vendor VAT status if they claim reverse-charge.
Clara (Legal): I'll draft the email and ping vendor contacts. If vendor is non-resident and VAT reverse-charge applies, please forward details — but given invoice shows VAT, they likely are charging VAT.
Maya Chen: Thank you! Small note: vendor says they charge a 10% admin fee for bookings; I didn't realize when booking. I'll forward our booking confirmation.
Evan (Finance): OK — final. Reimbursement queued (tx ref: FIN-2026-8012). Expect funds to clear in ~2-3 business days. Will update once vendor sends corrected invoice or we receive refund/credit.
Maya Chen: Got it — thanks team. :pray:
